purpose: One fixed engineering composition before independent learning qualification

scope.trainable_object: one private Cell object per declared learning request

state_contracts.ordinary_result: ObjectiveStart, original Circuit result and durable bounded outbox
state_contracts.checkpoint: Original registered writer and compare-and-swap; explicit V1/V2 profile separation
state_contracts.delivery: Completed authenticated NextUse before ACK, including retained NoUpdate
state_contracts.uncertain_claim: Readback only; missing or partial checkpoint is not proof of non-execution
state_contracts.root_bootstrap: Original profile/writer/lane identity and retained state; concrete stage owners required

development_comparison.task_family: repository diagnosis, repair and terminal verification
development_comparison.data: Previously exposed M6 R/S development material; original content pins retained with execution
development_comparison.model: Frozen lexical retrieval and one private association state; no language-model quality claim

production_materials.reason: No production material is supplied or authorized by these engineering source inputs; test keys and research receipts cannot substitute.

stage_dependencies.P0: Actual ordinary task result, learning or NoUpdate, different ordinary next use and cold recovery on this exact source
stage_dependencies.P1: Independent task groups, preregistered utility/error/retention/cost limits and strong complete terminal controls
stage_dependencies.P2: Separate matched-resource attribution of Cell differentiation, NDU and HCSN
stage_dependencies.P3: Established first-order gain plus full organization search, migration, drain, retraining and rollback costs
stage_dependencies.P4: Qualified multi-generation comparisons, including frozen and history-matched non-inheriting improvers
